extra_vocab.en: a pain in your head, or a problem that makes you worried
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於請假、健康和職場問題的情境。除了真的頭痛，也常比喻「麻煩事」，如 a big headache。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: headache 是可數名詞，要加冠詞：I have a headache（不是 I have headache）。

example.en: Small mistakes in orders created many headaches last month.
example.zh: 訂單中的小錯誤上個月造成許多麻煩。

example.en: Several staff members had a headache after the long meeting.
example.zh: 開完那場很長的會後，有幾位員工頭痛。

example.en: The software update turned out to be a big headache.
example.zh: 這次軟體更新最後變成一件大麻煩。

example.en: Missing parts can cause headaches for the whole production line.
example.zh: 缺少零件可能給整條生產線造成麻煩。

examples.en: I have a headache, so I will leave work early today.
examples.zh: 我頭痛，所以今天會提早下班。

examples.en: The new schedule system has been a headache for everyone.
examples.zh: 新的排程系統對每個人來說都很麻煩。

examples.en: Late shipments are a big problem and a headache for our sales team.
examples.zh: 延遲出貨是大問題，也讓我們的業務團隊很頭痛。

confusable.diff: 拼法開頭相同，但 headline 是新聞或文章的標題，不是頭痛。

example.en: The headline on the front page is about our new product.
example.zh: 頭版的標題是關於我們的新產品。

similar.diff: problem 是中性的「問題」；headache 是口語，強調讓人煩惱、很麻煩。

example.en: The shipping delay is a serious problem for us.
example.zh: 出貨延遲對我們來說是個嚴重的問題。

example.en: He has had back pain since the long flight.
example.zh: 自從那趟長途飛行後，他一直背痛。

example.en: Please take this medicine after you eat lunch.
example.zh: 請在吃完午餐後服用這個藥。

example.en: Too much stress can hurt your work performance.
example.zh: 過大的壓力會傷害你的工作表現。

example.en: I took some medicine because I had a bad headache.
example.zh: 我頭很痛，所以吃了一些藥。

senses.en: a person or thing that causes problems
senses.distinguish: 主詞是事情或系統，不是人在頭痛時，指麻煩事。

example.en: Changing suppliers in the middle of the year is a headache.
example.zh: 年中更換供應商是件很麻煩的事。

extra_vocab.en: able to hurt people or cause damage
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於產品警告標示、環保、食品安全和資訊安全的情境，常用 harmful to + 對象。語氣中性偏正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: harmful 後面接 to 加受害對象：harmful to your health、harmful to the environment，不用 for。

example.en: Long working hours can be harmful to your health.
example.zh: 長時間工作可能對你的健康有害。

example.en: The study found no harmful effects from the new material.
example.zh: 這項研究沒有發現這種新材料有任何有害影響。

example.en: Workers should avoid contact with harmful chemicals at all times.
example.zh: 員工任何時候都應避免接觸有害化學物質。

examples.en: The factory stopped using a harmful substance in its products.
examples.zh: 這間工廠已經不再在產品中使用有害物質。

examples.en: The label warns that the product may be harmful if swallowed.
examples.zh: 標籤警告這項產品若吞下可能有害。

examples.en: Delete any email that contains harmful links or files.
examples.zh: 請刪除任何含有有害連結或檔案的電子郵件。

confusable.diff: hurtful 指話語或行為「傷人感情的」；harmful 指對健康、環境等造成實際傷害。

example.en: His hurtful comment upset many of the staff members.
example.zh: 他傷人的評論讓許多員工感到難過。

similar.diff: dangerous 強調有立即的危險；harmful 強調可能造成傷害，可能是長期的。

example.en: It is dangerous to enter the site without a helmet.
example.zh: 沒戴安全帽進入工地很危險。

similar.diff: damaging 常用在對名聲、關係或結果的傷害，如 damaging to our image。

example.en: The false news was damaging to our company image.
example.zh: 這則假消息傷害了我們公司的形象。

example.en: There is a small risk of delay in shipping.
example.zh: 出貨有一點延遲的風險。

example.en: Toxic waste must be stored in sealed containers.
example.zh: 有毒廢棄物必須存放在密封的容器裡。

derived.link: 詞幹 harm，意思是「傷害」；也可當動詞「傷害」

extra_vocab.en: slow to act because you are not sure
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於會議、談判和客戶回應的情境，描述對決定或行動猶豫不決。常用 be hesitant to + V。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: be hesitant to 後面接原形動詞（hesitant to approve）；接名詞或 V-ing 時用 hesitant about。

example.en: Please do not be hesitant to contact me with questions.
example.zh: 有任何問題，請不要猶豫，隨時聯絡我。

example.en: Many investors are hesitant about entering the new market now.
example.zh: 許多投資人現在對進入新市場感到猶豫。

example.en: His hesitant reply showed that he was not ready.
example.zh: 他遲疑的回答顯示他還沒有準備好。

examples.en: Some managers were hesitant to approve the large budget.
examples.zh: 有些經理對批准這筆龐大預算感到猶豫。

examples.en: The client is hesitant about signing a long contract.
examples.zh: 客戶對簽一份長期合約感到猶豫。

examples.en: She gave a hesitant answer when asked about her salary.
examples.zh: 被問到薪水時，她給了一個遲疑的回答。

similar.diff: reluctant 是心裡不情願；hesitant 是因為不確定而遲疑。

example.en: Staff were reluctant to accept the new working hours.
example.zh: 員工不願意接受新的上班時間。

similar.diff: unsure 只是不確定；hesitant 強調因為不確定而遲遲不行動。

example.en: I am unsure about the delivery date for this order.
example.zh: 我不確定這筆訂單的交貨日期。

example.en: There is no doubt that sales will grow next year.
example.zh: 毫無疑問，明年的銷售會成長。

example.en: The bank is cautious about giving loans to new firms.
example.zh: 銀行對於貸款給新公司很謹慎。

derived.link: 詞幹 hesitate，動詞「猶豫」；常說 Don't hesitate to call me
hesitate 去掉 e 加 -ion，變成名詞，像 decide → decision

extra_vocab.en: the system that connects computers around the world
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於資訊科技、辦公室、飯店設施和網路購物的情境，常說 internet access、internet connection。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: internet 通常加 the（on the internet），是不可數名詞，沒有複數 s。

example.en: The hotel offers free internet access in every guest room.
example.zh: 這間飯店每間客房都提供免費上網服務。

example.en: Please check your internet connection before the video call starts.
example.zh: 視訊通話開始前，請先檢查你的網路連線。

example.en: You can find our price list on the internet.
example.zh: 你可以在網路上找到我們的價目表。

example.en: Many people now pay their bills with internet banking.
example.zh: 現在許多人用網路銀行繳帳單。

examples.en: Many customers compare prices on the internet before they buy.
examples.zh: 許多顧客在購買前會先在網路上比價。

examples.en: Our staff answer customer questions through the internet and by phone.
examples.zh: 我們的員工透過網路和電話回答客戶的問題。

examples.en: The internet was down for an hour this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上網路中斷了一個小時。

confusable.diff: intranet 是公司或學校的內部網路，只有內部人員能用；internet 是對全世界開放的網路。

example.en: Staff can find the holiday schedule on the company intranet.
example.zh: 員工可以在公司內部網路上找到假期時間表。

similar.diff: web 指網頁和網站的世界（World Wide Web）；internet 是整個網路系統，兩者日常常混用。

example.en: Our new website will go live on the web next week.
example.zh: 我們的新網站下週會在網路上上線。

example.en: Please visit our website to see the full product list.
example.zh: 請上我們的網站查看完整的產品清單。

example.en: The company offers an online course for new staff.
example.zh: 公司為新員工提供線上課程。

example.en: The office network is slow in the afternoon.
example.zh: 辦公室的網路在下午很慢。

extra_vocab.zh: 資訊豐富的、有教育性的
extra_vocab.en: giving you a lot of useful facts
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於研討會、手冊、網站和報告，用來稱讚內容提供許多有用資訊。形容的是事物，不是人。

example.en: She wrote an informative article about the new tax rules.
example.zh: 她寫了一篇關於新稅制、資訊豐富的文章。

example.en: Thank you for the informative session on data safety.
example.zh: 謝謝你舉辦這場資訊豐富的資料安全說明會。

example.en: Many participants found the workshop informative and useful.
example.zh: 許多參加者覺得這場工作坊很有收穫，也很實用。

examples.en: The seminar was short but very informative for new staff.
examples.zh: 這場研討會雖然短，但對新進員工來說資訊非常豐富。

examples.en: The brochure is clear, informative, and easy to read.
examples.zh: 這本小冊子清楚、資訊豐富又容易閱讀。

examples.en: Our website has an informative page about each product.
examples.zh: 我們的網站為每項產品都有一頁資訊豐富的介紹。

confusable.diff: informed 是「消息靈通的、被告知的」；informative 是「提供很多資訊的」。
confusable.usage: informative 修飾資料、文章或活動；informed 常修飾人：be informed、keep me informed。

example.en: Please keep me informed about any change in the schedule.
example.zh: 行程只要有任何變動，請隨時告知我。

similar.diff: useful 強調有用、派得上用場；informative 強調提供許多資訊或知識。

example.en: This guide is useful for first-time visitors to the city.
example.zh: 這本指南對第一次來這座城市的訪客很有用。

example.en: Please send me more information about the new product.
example.zh: 請寄給我更多關於新產品的資訊。

example.en: The brochure lists all our services and prices.
example.zh: 這本小冊子列出了我們所有的服務和價格。

example.en: Please check every detail in the contract before signing.
example.zh: 簽約前，請檢查合約中的每個細節。

derived.link: 詞幹 inform，動詞「通知」；加 -ative 變成「提供資訊的」
inform + -ation，變成名詞「資訊」，像 organize → organization

extra_vocab.en: an organization for research, study, or special training
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於研究機構、教育訓練和公告的情境，如 research institute。動詞用法是正式說法，表示開始實施制度或政策。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: institute 當動詞時是正式用語，意思是「開始實施」，受詞常是 policy、system、rule。

example.en: Several institutes joined the conference on clean energy.
example.zh: 有幾間研究機構參加了清潔能源的會議。

example.en: The city institutes new parking rules at the start of the year.
example.zh: 市政府在年初實施新的停車規定。

example.en: The board instituted stricter rules for travel expenses last year.
example.zh: 董事會去年實施了更嚴格的差旅費規定。

example.en: Instituting a new system will take about three months.
example.zh: 實施新的系統大約需要三個月。

example.en: A research institute will test the new material for us.
example.zh: 一間研究機構會替我們測試這種新材料。

example.en: She took a course at a training institute last year.
example.zh: 她去年在一間培訓機構上了一門課。

example.en: The government plans to institute a policy to reduce waste.
example.zh: 政府計畫實施一項減少廢棄物的政策。

examples.en: The institute published a report on the local job market.
examples.zh: 這個研究機構發表了一份關於當地就業市場的報告。

examples.en: She studies business at an institute near the city center.
examples.zh: 她在市中心附近的一所學院讀商業。

examples.en: The company will institute a flexible schedule for all staff.
examples.zh: 公司將為所有員工實施彈性工時。

confusable.diff: institution 範圍更廣，指銀行、學校、醫院等大型機構，也可指制度；institute 多指研究或教育機構。

example.en: The bank is a large financial institution in Asia.
example.zh: 這間銀行是亞洲一家大型金融機構。

similar.diff: establish 是建立公司或組織；institute 當動詞是開始實施制度、規定。

example.en: The firm plans to establish a branch in Taipei.
example.zh: 公司計畫在台北設立一間分公司。

similar.diff: introduce 較口語，指推出新事物或新做法；institute 較正式，帶有「正式實施」的意思。

example.en: We will introduce a new payment method next week.
example.zh: 我們下週會推出一種新的付款方式。

example.en: She works for a non-profit organization in Taipei.
example.zh: 她在台北的一個非營利組織工作。

example.en: He teaches marketing at a university in the city center.
example.zh: 他在市區的一所大學教行銷。

example.en: The company runs a sales academy for new employees.
example.zh: 公司為新進員工開辦了一所業務學院。

derived.link: institute 去掉 e 加 -ution，變成名詞，指大型機構或制度

example.en: The institute offers short courses for business owners.
example.zh: 這個機構為企業主開設短期課程。

example.en: The hospital will institute new rules for visitors next week.
example.zh: 醫院下週將對訪客實施新規定。

senses.en: an organization that does research or study

example.en: The institute studies how people use mobile phones.
example.zh: 這個機構研究人們如何使用手機。

senses.zh: 專門的學校或培訓機構
senses.en: a school that gives special training
senses.distinguish: 出現 course、training、teach 時，指培訓學校。

example.en: He joined a language institute to improve his English.
example.zh: 他加入一間語言學校來提升英文。

extra_vocab.en: the way your voice goes up and down when you speak
extra_vocab.note: 多益聽力常考說話者的語氣和意圖，語調是重要線索；也常出現在電話禮儀、簡報和英語學習的情境。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: intonation 通常是不可數名詞，不加 a：have good intonation。

example.en: Different intonations can change the meaning of a short sentence.
example.zh: 不同的語調可以改變一個短句的意思。

example.en: Questions often end with a rising intonation in English.
example.zh: 英文的問句句尾常用上升語調。

example.en: A falling intonation usually shows that you have finished speaking.
example.zh: 下降語調通常表示你已經說完了。

example.en: Reading aloud every day can improve your intonation.
example.zh: 每天朗讀可以改善你的語調。

examples.en: A friendly intonation makes phone calls sound more polite.
examples.zh: 友善的語調讓電話聽起來更有禮貌。

examples.en: Good intonation keeps listeners interested during a long presentation.
examples.zh: 好的語調能讓聽眾在長時間的簡報中保持興趣。

examples.en: From his intonation, we could tell he was asking a question.
examples.zh: 從他的語調，我們可以聽出他是在問問題。

examples.en: Our English class practices stress and intonation every Friday.
examples.zh: 我們的英文課每週五練習重音和語調。

confusable.diff: tone 是整體的語氣和口吻（用詞、態度）；intonation 是聲音的高低起伏。

example.en: The tone of his email was polite but firm.
example.zh: 他的電子郵件語氣有禮貌但很堅定。

confusable.diff: pronunciation 是單字怎麼發音；intonation 是整句話的音調變化。

example.en: Her pronunciation is clear, so clients understand her easily.
example.zh: 她的發音很清楚，所以客戶很容易聽懂她。

example.en: The stress in this word falls on the second part.
example.zh: 這個字的重音落在第二個音節。

example.en: Our manager has a slight accent when she speaks English.
example.zh: 我們經理說英文時帶著一點口音。

extra_vocab.en: to make someone feel angry or annoyed
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於客訴、職場抱怨和產品警告標示。可指讓人心煩，也可指對皮膚或眼睛造成不適。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「人感到惱怒」用 be irritated；「事物令人惱怒」用 irritating：I am irritated / The noise is irritating。

example.en: Slow internet service irritates everyone in the sales office.
example.zh: 網路速度很慢讓業務辦公室裡的每個人都很煩。

example.en: The constant noise irritated the staff all afternoon.
example.zh: 持續的噪音讓員工一整個下午都很煩。

example.en: The irritated client asked to speak with a manager.
example.zh: 那位惱怒的客戶要求和經理說話。

example.en: Repeated mistakes in the invoices are irritating our best customers.
example.zh: 發票上一再出現的錯誤正在惹惱我們最好的客戶。

example.en: The constant beeping from the machine is really irritating.
example.zh: 機器不斷發出的嗶嗶聲真的很煩人。

example.en: Poor service will irritate customers and hurt sales.
example.zh: 糟糕的服務會惹惱顧客，也會傷害銷售。

example.en: The manager was irritated by the late reports.
example.zh: 經理被那些遲交的報告惹惱了。

example.en: Some strong soaps can irritate the skin and eyes.
example.zh: 有些強效的肥皂可能會刺激皮膚和眼睛。

examples.en: Long waiting times irritate our guests during busy periods.
examples.zh: 忙碌時段，長時間的等待會惹惱我們的客人。

examples.en: Loud phone calls can irritate people who work nearby.
examples.zh: 大聲講電話可能會惹惱在附近工作的人。

examples.en: This cleaner may irritate your skin, so wear gloves.
examples.zh: 這種清潔劑可能刺激皮膚，所以請戴手套。

confusable.diff: 拼法和發音相近，但 imitate 是「模仿」，不是惹惱。

example.en: Many small firms imitate the methods of larger companies.
example.zh: 許多小公司模仿大公司的做法。

similar.diff: annoy 較日常，程度較輕；irritate 常指持續的小事讓人煩躁，也可指皮膚刺激。

example.en: Constant phone calls annoy the staff in the office.
example.zh: 不斷的電話讓辦公室裡的員工很煩。

similar.diff: bother 是打擾、讓人不舒服，語氣最輕，常用在問句，如 Does it bother you?

example.en: Does the noise from the street bother you?
example.zh: 街上的噪音會打擾你嗎？

example.en: The customer was angry about the late delivery.
example.zh: 顧客對延遲交貨很生氣。

example.en: We received three complaints about the noise last week.
example.zh: 上週我們收到三件關於噪音的投訴。

example.en: The client was upset about the late delivery.
example.zh: 客戶對延遲交貨感到不開心。

derived.link: irritate 去掉 e 加 -ion，變成名詞，像 decide → decision
irritate 的 -ate 換成 -able，容易被激怒的，像 comfortable

senses.en: to make someone feel angry or annoyed

example.en: Slow replies irritate clients who need quick answers.
example.zh: 回覆太慢會惹惱需要快速答覆的客戶。

senses.en: to make part of the body feel sore
senses.distinguish: 主詞是化學品、灰塵或肥皂時，指刺激身體。

example.en: Dust in the factory can irritate workers' eyes.
example.zh: 工廠裡的灰塵可能刺激員工的眼睛。
